notes.title: Retry Mode and Declining Enemy Force
notes.content:
Today's update changes the gameplay to the better, based in your suggestions and wishes (Thanks to Wolf Michael).

Changelog:
- If you lose a battle the enemy force will also lose their fallen soldiers. The enemy doesn't refill soldiers to full strength, like it was before.
- If a battle goes horribly wrong, you can now retreat/retry while in battle, to try again.
- Integrated new art style.

I hope you like it. :)
Have fun & Cheers,
Gabriel

notes.title: Bugfix/Balancing Update
notes.content:
Update 1.0.7:
- Fixed bug where the game didn't save an improved highscore in the statistics.
- The loot and recruit chances of liberated sectors will now recover slowly.

Thanks for your feedback. :)
Have fun!

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
Update 1.0.6:
- Increased minimum loot and recruit chance
- Increased recruit chances in mid game
- Changed enemy equipment slightly in mid game
- Made inventory bottom note more visible
- Achievements should appear while playing now, instead of after closing the game
- Added info popup to remind you of save games

Thanks for your feedback. :)
Have fun!

notes.title: First Update: Bugfixes and Improvements!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.4:
- IMPROVED DRAG AND DROP SOLDIER PLACEMENT
- Fixed bug where you were able to rest without spending days
- Fixed bug where the "Day" counter wouldn't reset after you press "New Game"
- Game now runs in background
- Reduced waiting times at the end of Rest screen by 1 second
- Your current soldier count now also shows the maximum amount possible. Like "Soldiers (12/24)"
- The currently selected soldier is now underlined
- Some game balancing

Thanks for your feedback. :)
Have fun!
